main_text.p: & podagræ calidæ, sed periculum est ne lentæ hæc in meatu vrinario, aut vesica, si eam adi bunt, partium calore tandem siccata, vel ob turent, vel angustent meatum, & malu succedat nouum, priore etiam deterius. Valentius fiet remediu additis caphuræ granis 3. 4. valentissimum addito opij grano vno, vel troch. halicac. script. vno aqua vel decocto ne papaueris soluto. Virgam quoque tenere in lacte calido, vel decocto papaueris albi, inungere ventrem inferiorem, & perinæum oleo salicum, violato, nymphæ, addita pauca camphura. Decoctum foliorum vitis, salicis, malvæ, violæ, infessu, aut fotu ex vesica.
main_text.head: MICTVS SANGVINIS CVRATIO.
main_text.p: SANGVIS mictu redditur, quum is est quantitate aut qualitate acri, & biliosa, vel aquosa, aut quantitate & qualitate alienus: interdum ab imbecillitate secretis hepatis, renu. Est quando vase in partibus vreticis erosio, calculi attritu lacerato, rupto, lapsu, percussu, vel alio motu violento reddituR:

page.notes: Printed page has a large woodcut-style initial S in "SANGVIS". Bottom of page has no catchword. Some words uncertain: "malu" (malvæ), "camphura" read as "caphuræ" in the printed line; "reddituR" printed with a final capital-looking R, transcribed as printed.
